sec: GPCR hormone map, cGMP and TKR · p835

items.q: Which hypothalamic hormone signals via cAMP?
items.exp: Hypothalamus: CRH uses cAMP; TRH and GnRH use IP3/DAG. (Book p835)

items.q: The anterior pituitary hormones that use cAMP are:
items.exp: Anterior pituitary cAMP hormones: ACTH, FSH, LH, TSH. (Book p835)

items.q: Match vasopressin/oxytocin receptor to messenger — 1) V2  2) V1, V3, oxytocin … A) IP3/DAG  B) cAMP
items.exp: Posterior pituitary: V2 uses cAMP; V1, V3 and oxytocin use IP3/DAG. (Book p835)

items.q: The vasoconstrictors that signal via IP3/DAG are:
items.exp: Vasoconstrictors using IP3/DAG: AT II and substance P. (Book p835)

items.q: Match ANS receptor to messenger — 1) α2 (Gi) and β  2) α1 and acetylcholine receptors … A) IP3/DAG  B) cAMP
items.exp: ANS: α2 (Gi) and β use cAMP; α1 and acetylcholine receptors use IP3/DAG. (Book p835)

items.q: The GIT hormones using cAMP are:
items.exp: GIT cAMP: secretin, glucagon, somatostatin (Gi); IP3/DAG: CCK, gastrin. (Book p835)

items.q: The miscellaneous hormones signalling via cAMP are:
items.exp: Miscellaneous cAMP hormones: PTH and calcitonin. (Book p835)

items.q: ‘Gi is inhibitory and lowers cAMP; all other G proteins listed are Gs (stimulatory).’
items.exp: Gi is inhibitory (↓cAMP); all others are Gs stimulatory. V = vasopressin, AT II = angiotensin II. (Book p835)

items.q: The two cGMP-mediated vasodilators listed are:
opts: Nitric oxide and atrial natriuretic factor (ANF)
items.exp: cGMP vasodilators: nitric oxide and ANF. (Book p835)

items.q: The most potent vasoconstrictor named is:
items.exp: Note: urotensin is the most potent vasoconstrictor. (Book p835)

items.q: The TKR mechanism in order is: monomer receptor → ligand →
items.exp: TKR: ligand causes intracellular dimerisation then receptor autophosphorylation. (Book p835)

items.q: Insulin signals through the TKR by activating which pathway to mobilise GLUT4?
items.exp: Insulin activates the PI3K Akt 1/2 pathway, activating GLUT4 (IRS→PI3K→PDK1→Akt). (Book p835)

items.q: All of the following use TKR EXCEPT:
items.exp: Growth factors use TKR except TGF β (which uses STKR). (Book p835)

items.q: GLUT4 mediates insulin-dependent glucose uptake in:
opts: Adipose tissue, skeletal muscle and heart
items.exp: GLUT4 insulin-dependent uptake occurs in adipose tissue, skeletal muscle and heart. (Book p835)
